proposals.evidence: Turner *dvalati is explicitly intransitive burn, with Hindi barnā/balnā, Old Marwari balaï and Gujarati baḷvũ. The survey’s simple baḷ-/bar-/bol- responses and inflections fit that family. Long-vowel transitive bāl- kindle responses are kept separate.

proposals.evidence: All three components of the progressive predicate are linked: intransitive burn (*dvalati), remain (*rahati) and the present h-/ch- copula (ākṣeti). Turner explicitly covers Hindi hai and Gujarati che in the copula article. Regional rī/ry- reductions are retained, and the whole response is analysed.
